market: India PEM & AEM Electrolyzers for Green Hydrogen Projects Market
market_definition: The PEM & AEM Electrolyzers for Green Hydrogen Projects Market refers to the sales of Proton Exchange Membrane (PEM) and Anion Exchange Membrane (AEM) electrolyzers that use renewable electricity to split water into hydrogen and oxygen, producing green hydrogen. The market covers electrolyzer stacks and integrated systems deployed across industrial and commercial green hydrogen projects. By Product: PEM Electrolyzers, AEM Electrolyzers. By Configuration: Electrolyzer Stacks, Integrated Electrolyzer Systems. By System Capacity: Below 1 MW, 1 MW to Below 5 MW, 5 MW to Below 20 MW, 20 MW and Above. By Application: Green Ammonia Production, Petroleum Refining, Iron & Steel Manufacturing, Chemical Manufacturing, Energy Storage & Power, Other Industrial Applications. By End User: Green Hydrogen Project Developers, Industrial Hydrogen Producers, Captive Industrial Users, Utilities & Energy Companies. Geography: India-headquartered companies only. EXCLUDED: Alkaline Water Electrolyzers (AWE), Solid Oxide Electrolyzers (SOEC), hydrogen fuel cells, hydrogen storage, transportation and distribution, and grey, blue and brown hydrogen production equipment - and companies that deal only in those.
who_is_included: DISTRIBUTOR / CHANNEL PARTNER DEFINITION (hardware + software market): this market sells both hardware and software, so two shapes qualify - a stocking or authorized DISTRIBUTOR buying hardware in volume and reselling it, and a CHANNEL PARTNER, value-added reseller or SYSTEM INTEGRATOR that resells, bundles or implements another vendor's platform, software or modules. EXCLUDED: manufacturers, OEMs and their sales subsidiaries; vendors selling their own platform; consultancies with nothing to resell; and consumer-only retailers. Continent / Geography = countries with a physical site (HQ, office, warehouse, plant). Operational Presence = every country the company does business in, which is WIDER. Blank or NPD in a contact column means no published evidence was found - it is never a guess.
